# Prompt Anatomy

> Bilingual AI training hub: prompt engineering, context architecture, agents, automation. Canonical: https://www.promptanatomy.app/

Prompt Anatomy (`promptanatomy.app`) is the conversion hub for LT/EN checkout, access, and the interactive training app. The Six-Block Method is the Prompt Anatomy canon; five-part tools on ecosystem spokes are Quick mode and map onto the six blocks. For exhaustive FAQ, hero, and pricing copy, prefer https://www.promptanatomy.app/llms-full.txt. Ecosystem spokes are free workflow tools that route back to this hub.

## Main

- [Home EN](https://www.promptanatomy.app/): Default English landing (canonical)
- [Home LT](https://www.promptanatomy.app/lt): Lithuanian landing
- [Home EN share URL](https://www.promptanatomy.app/en): Routable share URL; canonical consolidates to /
- [Pricing](https://www.promptanatomy.app/#pricing): Starter and Core offers
- [FAQ](https://www.promptanatomy.app/#faq): Common questions and answers
- [Full LLM index](https://www.promptanatomy.app/llms-full.txt): Complete AI dump: FAQ LT/EN, hero, pricing

## Ecosystem

- [Hub (conversion)](https://www.promptanatomy.app/): Hub — pricing, checkout, access, conversion
- [Training app](https://www.promptanatomy.app/anatomy/): Interactive training app (modules 1–9, 6-block methodology; Stripe Core checkout sells 1–6; 7–9 via operator/cohort upgrade)
- [Ecosystem discovery map (.site)](https://promptanatomy.site): Discovery — full 9-domain journey map, maturity quiz, Prompt Builder
- [PromptAnatomy Cloud (.cloud)](https://promptanatomy.cloud/): Spoke — Enter: onboarding and first lesson, routing to hub (LT: https://promptanatomy.cloud/)
- [Prompt library (.info)](https://www.promptanatomy.info/en/): Spoke — Use: prompt library and daily automation workflows (LT: https://www.promptanatomy.info/lt/)
- [Content system (.space)](https://www.promptanatomy.space/en/): Spoke — Create: marketing content prompts and templates (LT: https://www.promptanatomy.space/)
- [HR system (.help)](https://promptanatomy.help/): Spoke — Hire: HR, recruitment, and people operations prompts (LT: https://promptanatomy.help/)
- [Operations center (.ceo)](https://www.promptanatomy.ceo/): Spoke — Manage: CEO/COO leadership and operations prompts (LT: https://www.promptanatomy.ceo/)
- [PromptAnatomy Pro (.pro)](https://promptanatomy.pro/): Spoke — Decide: B2B scaling and enterprise AI workflows routing to hub (LT: https://promptanatomy.pro/)
- [Knowledge hub (.blog)](https://promptanatomy.blog/): Spoke — Deepen: articles, canvases, and systems-thinking content (LT: https://promptanatomy.blog/)
- [Playground (.lol)](https://promptanatomy.lol/): Spoke — Play: structured sandbox for low-stakes prompt experiments (LT: https://promptanatomy.lol/)
- [Community (Telegram)](https://t.me/prompt_anatomy): Public practitioner support group
